_schema_note: positions.<TICKER> fields: executed_tier (0/1/2/3), current_stage (IDLE/TIER1/TIER2/TIER3), last_triggered_at (ISO8601 or null), rsi_peak, highest_price_since_buy, last_avg_cost, last_shares. last_avg_cost/last_shares must be refreshed every run regardless of whether a new tier triggered, so the next run's change-detection compares against the true previous reading. A ticker missing from positions is first-run init, not a reset.
